name: PS2 Style
summary: Turn any idea, your city, a game or your own brand into prompts in the 2000s PS2 game look, like GTA San Andreas. Free Style videos of 5 to 15 seconds, the viral "how X must feel like" reel, brand promos, character sheets from your photo and empty game worlds.
use_when: You want a PS2 or GTA San Andreas style image or video; a retro low-poly game look; to turn yourself into a PS2 game character from a photo; the viral "how [city, game, film] must feel like" reel; your clothing brand or product in a PS2 game promo; empty PS2 game environments; or the next shot after an image you already made.
produces: Copy-ready image prompts (single shot, panel shot or continue from your image), each with its matching timestamped video prompt in the same reply; 5 to 15 second Free Style videos; the 8-shot Nostalgia reel with an edit plan and cut points; promo shots built around your product photo; a four-view character sheet; connected empty environments; idea menus of 10 and five next-shot ideas under every shot; model, attach and settings lines for GPT Image 2 and Wan 3.0; optional generation through the OpenArt or Higgsfield MCP.
